summary: Requirements for distros to be added to the install guide: reasonably current ansible, ansible and ansible-core kept in sync, maintainer contact info, and ideally joining the Ansible Packaging Matrix room.
questions: How can a distro get its Ansible install instructions added to the docs?

answer_card.title: Adding a distribution to the guide
answer_card.answer_md:
Package maintainers must:
- ship a reasonably up-to-date `ansible`
- keep `ansible` and `ansible-core` versions in sync where possible
- include a way to contact the maintainers
- ideally join the Ansible Packaging Matrix room
